_about: The packet obligation ledger (ShipLoop efficiency plan G-LEDGER, unit U5). One row per obligation a packet carries: what the model must be told or given, where it must stand (surface: head = the printed text a reader cut short sees; file = the packet file, which holds everything), which packets it holds in (kinds: producer = the 24 stage packets, improve = the Improve parent packet; when = only where the file holds the named token), and the anchor tokens that prove it is present. An anchor is a group of alternatives (any): the obligation is met when any one is in the text; every anchor of a row must be met, in every in-scope packet, on both delegation routes, in the dry-run walk of the whole graph and in the offline step slice. `source` is the file the wording lives in: test/shiploop-packet-obligations.test.py reads it and fails when no alternative is there, so a token is derived from source and not invented. A row is added after the obligation is confirmed present; a unit that moves or rewords an obligation changes its row in the same commit and says why. Snapshot: main da9e2e75, ShipLoop 1.5.0.
